name: microstream-monorepo
description: MicroStream — Real-Time Micro-Credit Streaming for Gig Workers

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
